text:
maria: Heads-up: ACME customer flagged console tokens/sec showing -1200 for multiple windows, started ~09:15 UTC. Dashboard path: Console > Streaming > TTFT. Account: acme_inc. Can SRE take a look?
aj: On it. Can you paste a screenshot or the raw query time range?
maria: Screenshot uploaded: https://redwood.screenshots/acme/neg-tokens-0915.png. They also see first_token_latency spike. No deploys on their account per console.
opsbot: alert: rollup-service consumer group "stream-rollups" restarted at 2025-06-22T09:12:45Z (offsets reassigned)
aj: Hmm consumer restart at 09:12 — pulling rollup logs now. If windows get partial replays we sometimes see sign flips when deltas mishandled.
aj: Logs (filtered):
```
2025-06-22T09:12:46Z INFO account=acme_inc window=2025-06-22T09:09:00 delta=-1250 tokens_delta=-1250
2025-06-22T09:12:46Z INFO account=acme_inc window=2025-06-22T09:09:00 seen_partial=true replay=true
```
jake: We shipped a config change last week to align rollup windows to the local epoch (PR #3421) to reduce boundary drift. That toggle (`rollup.align_to_wallclock=false`) can produce mismatched partials across consumer restarts. Not seen this sign flip before though.
aj: Reproduced locally by killing the consumer and replaying partials with different epoch alignment — partial subtraction can go negative if the previous full-window checkpoint is missing. Our clamping path only applied when window_complete=true.
aj: Short-term mitigation: enable strict clamping and run a backfill for affected range. Commands I'm going to run on canary:
```
kubectl -n prod set env deployment/rollup ROLLUP_CLAMP_STRICT=true
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/rollup
curl -XPOST https://internal-api/rollup/backfill -d '{"start":"2025-06-22T09:00","end":"2025-06-22T09:30","account":"acme_inc"}'
```
maria: Please keep me posted so I can update the customer. Any ETA for the backfill?
ops-oncall: Canary restart succeeded, no new negatives observed. Backfill job queued on cluster (job id rollup-backfill-4987). Estimated completion ~45m. :thumbsup:
acme-support-bot: ACME: Thanks for the quick response, waiting for fix.
aj: Backfill finished at 2025-06-22T10:04:12Z. Verified dashboards for acme_inc show tokens/sec normalized and TTFT windows look sane. I'll open PR #3428 to revert the epoch toggle or make it opt-in per-account and add stricter unit tests for replay clamping.
maria: Great, I'll update the customer and close the support ticket once they confirm. Please add a short postmortem in #postmortems next week. Thanks everyone.
